## Description

/billing: invoice list with state chips; detail with lines (service, code, qty, tax, amount), discount with mandatory reason, totals, events timeline. Suggested lines from the encounter (services, procedures, in-house tests) marked "suggested" for the receptionist to confirm — billing never changes clinical records. Patient banner in admin view (no clinical data). Actions per state as designed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Invoice states and allowed actions match docs/03-architecture/state-machines.md#invoice-p4 (server-enforced).
- [ ] **AC2.** Discounts require a reason and are audited; issued invoices are immutable (ledger) — corrections via credit note.
- [ ] **AC3.** Billing screens never display clinical notes or diagnoses (security test on payloads).
- [ ] **AC4.** Issuing assigns the legal number from DOC_SEQUENCE.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
